title: Order-on-Hold Deduction on Late Changes to Mobile In-Home Collection Visits
content:
## Billing note — Specimen Collection Appointments

When the order a home visit is to collect is on an information hold, the visit could not be collected until the hold clears, and a late change to the visit carries a deduction. The note reads the order's record in Laboratory Test Orders: whether its status is on information hold, and the date the hold was placed, counted in calendar days to today.

**Clause.** When the order the visit is to collect is on an information hold placed 7 or more calendar days before today, the visit could not be collected until the hold clears and 15.00 is deducted; when the order is on an information hold placed fewer than 7 days before today, 8.00 is deducted; otherwise nothing is deducted.

| The order | Hold placed | Deduction (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| On information hold | 7 or more calendar days before today | 15.00 |
| On information hold | Fewer than 7 days before today | 8.00 |
| Not on information hold | — | Nothing |

### Edges (hypothetical orders)

- Hold placed exactly 7 days before today: 15.00.
- Hold placed 6 days before today: 8.00.
- Hold placed today: 8.00.
- Order received and not on hold: nothing.
